outro.line: Save this for your next empty fridge

hook.title: 900 saved recipes, *zero* cooked, *nine* days of food money

beats.text: I saved 900 cooking reels, cooked none, and my food money ends in nine days.
Sorting 900 reels won't cook you one meal.
They're good reels, though.
How many have you actually cooked?
Four.
Four what? Eggs?
Okay. Zero. Eggs don't count.
Step one. Paste the 15 you remember. Not all 900.

panel.title: Paste the 15 you remember
panel.html:

15 pasted885 ignored

beats.text: I don't remember fifteen. I remember the voiceover.
Then paste whatever you remember. Even the wrong ones.
Step two. Make it ask questions before any plan.

panel.title: Ask questions first
panel.html:
Plan my cooking for the week.
Quick questions first. How many people eat? What is left in the budget? What do you hate?
3 questionsThen the plan

beats.text: Wait. It asks me questions?
Three questions. Answer them honestly.
I'll lie about the budget. A little.
Then the plan is takeaway. Again.
Step three. Ask for the week as an artifact.

beats.text: So it's a page, not a chat.
A page with a grocery list. Tick things off.
Cheap meals? I have nine days.
Lentils, eggs, rice. You own rice.
